**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Strip lab metadata from unauthorized projections**

At reviewed head `5d8d71083db3f4f949ddd91a0b2f3f83ff19bdea`, when privacy, lock/fullscreen, or the selected role makes `allowed(a)` false, `publicItem()` masks the visible fields but still shallow-spreads this newly attached `labRef`. Consequently both `clinical:activity` and later snapshots disclose the stable report ID and `abnormalCount` to a client that failed authorization; omit `labRef` from the masked projection rather than relying on the UI not to render it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use a monotonic clock for the report lifetime**

At reviewed head `5d8d71083db3f4f949ddd91a0b2f3f83ff19bdea`, the elapsed budget is driven by `Date.now()`, so moving the system clock backward while an unpaused report is open stops elapsed time from accruing until wall time catches up. The Rust deadline protects only `nativeIsland`; browser and native-studio previews can therefore retain the report well beyond the intended 60-second lifetime. Base the budget on a monotonic source such as `performance.now()` while keeping wall-clock values out of elapsed-duration calculations.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid focusing the island merely to enable capture protection**

At reviewed head `5d8d71083db3f4f949ddd91a0b2f3f83ff19bdea`, `active` does not prove that the user clicked the island: a `clinical:view` broadcast enters the summary at `controller.ts:72`, calls `load()`, and invokes this command. The unconditional `set_focus()` then steals the foreground from the studio or the application where the user was typing; capture affinity should be applied without activation, with focusing reserved for a separately proven direct island click.
